snippet.title: project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape - Official Animated Release Window Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Release Window Announcement Trailer for project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape, a psychological horror life simulation RPG game developed by RIKANIMATION and boddiul. Players will embody Hicha who is hanging on by a thread with her virtual avatar, Virai, providing her only reason to continue on. Explore the emotional world with a variety of different art styles to dive into themes of parasocial relationships and the blurring of lines between real and virtual life. project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape is releasing in Q4 2025 for PC (Steam) with a demo available now.
